resources.string: This server does not support credential status
This server does not expose credential status checks. The credential can still be shared, and the recipient performs its own checks.
The previous result is out of date.
Some status references could not be checked.
The recipient may reject this credential.
This check only reports the issuer’s status information. It does not confirm every aspect of the credential’s validity. The recipient performs its own checks.
Checks contact the issuer’s status service. Credential contents and status indexes are not sent in the request.
The status information could not be authenticated. Any previous result is retained.
The latest check could not complete. Previous results keep their original check time.
The credential contains no status reference. This does not establish that it is valid.
The credential has a status reference that has not been checked yet.
This wallet cannot check this status method. The recipient may support it.
Check while the wallet is open and unlocked. No background checks.
Checked: %1$d · unchanged: %2$d · deferred: %3$d · with unavailable checks: %4$d
Deferred checks can be retried shortly.
Status issues affect the selected credentials below. The recipient may reject them.
Status information is shown for your review and is not an additional claim to share.
The credential is expired or not yet valid. Online status checks were skipped.
The credential’s status reference could not be authenticated. No status list was requested.
The credential contains an invalid status reference.
The status service asked to wait. Try again later.
This status check exceeds the wallet’s processing limits.
The issuer returned a status inconsistent with an earlier irreversible result. The earlier result is retained.
Status checking is disabled by the wallet host.
This wallet has multiple stored credentials with the same identifier. Status cannot be shown unambiguously.
